headline: As of 2026-10-11: 3,190,103 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+25.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,190,103 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+25.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,636), Florida (501,175), Michigan (386,495).
